sqliteMaster.name: nodes_parent
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE INDEX nodes_parent ON nodes(parent_id,sort_key,id)

sqliteMaster.name: _backup_revision
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE _backup_revision(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),format INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(format=1),lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL,storage_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(storage_epoch)='integer' AND storage_epoch>=0))

sqliteMaster.name: annotations
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE annotations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,note_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(node_id),target_asset_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(hash),page INTEGER NOT NULL,selector_json TEXT NOT NULL,quote TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,color TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,deleted_at INTEGER)

sqliteMaster.name: assets
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE assets(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,size INTEGER NOT NULL,mime TEXT NOT NULL)

sqliteMaster.name: capture_receipts
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE capture_receipts(capture_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,digest TEXT NOT NULL,note_id TEXT NOT NULL,applied_seq INTEGER NOT NULL)

sqliteMaster.name: changes
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE changes(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,operation TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

sqliteMaster.name: extension_data
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE extension_data(extension_id TEXT NOT NULL,key TEXT NOT NULL,value_json TEXT NOT NULL,schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,PRIMARY KEY(extension_id,key))

sqliteMaster.name: fts_notes
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE fts_notes USING fts5(note_id UNINDEXED,title,body,tokenize='trigram')

sqliteMaster.name: fts_notes_config
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'fts_notes_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

sqliteMaster.name: fts_notes_content
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'fts_notes_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2)

sqliteMaster.name: fts_notes_data
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'fts_notes_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

sqliteMaster.name: fts_notes_docsize
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'fts_notes_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

sqliteMaster.name: fts_notes_idx
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'fts_notes_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

sqliteMaster.name: import_reports
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE import_reports(note_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES notes(node_id),report_json TEXT NOT NULL)

sqliteMaster.name: nodes
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE nodes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,parent_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id),kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('folder','note')),title TEXT NOT NULL,sort_key INTEGER NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,deleted_at INTEGER,deleted_by TEXT,favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]')

sqliteMaster.name: note_links
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE note_links(source_note_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(node_id),target_notebook_id TEXT NOT NULL,target_note_id TEXT NOT NULL,anchor TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(source_note_id,target_notebook_id,target_note_id))

sqliteMaster.name: note_revisions
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE note_revisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,note_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(node_id),body TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user')

sqliteMaster.name: note_text
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE note_text(note_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES notes(node_id),asset_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(hash),body TEXT NOT NULL)

sqliteMaster.name: notebook_meta
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE notebook_meta(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,icon TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '❦',cover_color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#583a29',schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,content_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

sqliteMaster.name: notes
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE notes(node_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES nodes(id),note_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(note_type IN ('markdown','pdf','image')),head_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES note_revisions(id),primary_resource_id TEXT REFERENCES resources(id),source_uri TEXT)

sqliteMaster.name: resources
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE resources(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,asset_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(hash),original_name TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

sqliteMaster.name: revision_resources
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE revision_resources(revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES note_revisions(id),resource_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES resources(id),asset_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(hash),PRIMARY KEY(revision_id,resource_id))

sqliteMaster.name: sqlite_sequence
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
